description:
**Storno** a posted journal entry: post its mirror image (accountant role).

Nothing is deleted; the original stays, linked, and the **reversal** entry is returned.
The only VAT-correct storno door — VAT postings, open items and what the document
spawned are all unwound.

``body.posting_date`` dates the reversal and decides its period; omitted, it reuses
the original's. A closed-period entry needs one in an open period and a person:
the reversal is booked there; the entry stays unchanged.

**409** when: the entry is a reversal or already corrected; the date falls in a filed
VAT period; an open item still carries a live settlement; the target period is
closed or sealed; or a closed-period entry cannot be corrected (the reason is named).
name: reverse_gl_journal_entry
